paraphrase: The first chapter sets out who may be an astrologer and how he should live: learned in the three branches, of good conduct, performing his daily worship and recitation, pure and truthful; the words of such an astrologer come true.
notes: Chapter-level summary from memory; not spot-checked.

paraphrase: Afflictions found through the query are traced to curses and displeasure — of deities, serpents, ancestors, teachers and brahmins — and to spirits, and the appropriate expiations and worship are prescribed for each.
notes: Chapter number uncertain (content spread over the later chapters of the Praśna Mārga).
